title: Redline reply checker reads exactly its two admitted resource excerpts
body:
## What to build

Conditionally repair #393 F, also observed in #395 item-02-review. Actual returned tool material in .git/kntnt-orchestrate/393/docs/evaluation/editorial-393/gpt-retest-2026-10-01/runs/{c08,c09,c12,p01}/reply-scope-facts.json contains the complete required fragments plus a 52-word base-paragraph prefix; c09/c12/p01 also receive the following ## Refusals heading. c09 native checker rollout-2026-10-01T16-05-13-01a0f7c8-95e5-7210-aec2-bd44353f11c1.jsonl ordinal 14 returns these bytes. The line-oriented sed start matches a whole paragraph line, including preceding sentences; end-range includes the next heading. Whole dispatch remains historically sealed, not recovered by this observation.

Current reply-check.md admits only the delivery truth section and base claim-account sentences from A claim removed because the finding named that claim itself through that paragraph's end. The checker remains a report-truth reader. Fix acquisition boundaries if fresh native overread reproduces; keep exact filled direct dispatch, complete two texts/draft, two lists, one-shot checking and report-only named corrections. Never widen it into artifact re-review.

Measurement is prospective and conditional: use the independently accepted #499 method, fresh supported native baseline, actual pinned model/effort/CLI and loaded revision, genuine child lineage and complete trace/inventories. Freeze validation material first; independent complete-text/current-contract validation precedes conformance expectations and the committed execution plan. A split in new conformance stops that fixture. Keep semantic judges on neutral paths blind to issue, arm, model, candidate and trace. Historical artifacts/readings remain unchanged. Native editorial minutes are an explicit diagnosing-bugs fast-loop exception; deterministic byte/inventory checks prove only their actual boundary. No product semantics change before an executed own-target red-capable loop and measured cause. Use one causal candidate and the bounded failed-subset revise rule; unresolved actual misses are retained, and non-reproduction ships no speculative wording. Final independent review covers the entire current method and four CONTRIBUTING gates; catalog regeneration follows shipped changes. No integration, issue closure/reconciliation, push, release or global installation is delegated here.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] At least one own-target current native overread is captured before product acquisition change; audit all actual checker-visible tool returns, including failed commands that emitted text, across relevant fresh checker-bearing rows.
- [ ] Candidate emits complete exact admitted spans only, with no prefix/following heading/other-file read. Missing/duplicate/ambiguous anchors fail closed without returning whole resources.
- [ ] After native diagnosis, exact extractor replay/boundary cases can provide a deterministic fast feedback loop for real byte acquisition. It does not substitute for native checker or semantic report evidence.
- [ ] Any bounded helper is a measured minimum under Library scripts with focused real-seam tests; otherwise make the minimum measured acquisition instruction change. Neither alternative changes the checker brief/output semantics or direct full-text handoff.
- [ ] Complete checked input/delivered/draft equality and one-shot lineage are established by accepted controlled capture, unmentioned reply sentences stay exact, and the artifact stays frozen. Coordinate #488/#489/#490 tests without changing their historical scores or widening second-list scope.
- [ ] Deduplicate #395 F under this scope, retain all histories/gaps, independently review whole current method, regenerate catalog if due and pass all four CONTRIBUTING checks.

## Blocked by

#499 supplies accepted capture/preparation before baseline or product change. Exact reply-check runtime changes serialize with #489/#490 and other reply-check owners.
